title: Craftable usables
description: A mod that adds crafts for usable uncraftable items
body:
This mod was made with MCreator.

**Hello! This mod adds a feature to craft items that are uncraftable in survival!**

You want to get a barrier? Ok! Bedrock? Good!
You can get this type of useful things!

they are fully balanced, before getting them you have to craft **special items**:
![You need to craft special gems or gem blocks to craft this good items!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9e1a356a004bcadf7de380ff4721c6b70f975144.png)

This is hard! You can see the craft in mod **gallery**.
The crafts of items are also there.

I will make more different versions updates soon, but not sure when will that happen, this will be hard with MCreator.
